description.text: Discover how ETIC, New York Tech's business hub and accelerator for entrepreneurship and innovation, brings together industry, government, and academia to foster innovation.

targetApplicants.text: The ETIC has been designated as a Certified Incubator by the Empire State Development Corp. to provide support for start-up businesses, including entrepreneurial and high-tech training, commercialization guidance, networking opportunities, and staff recruitment.
